restaurant.name: Restaurant
lines: Vanakkam, Dhivya! Thanks for calling Chennai Spice House. Lovely to hear from you again. Would you like your usual chicken biryani?
Hi! Yes, please. Can you make it medium spicy? And add a mango lassi.
Of course. One chicken biryani, medium spice, and one mango lassi. That comes to $22.66 with tax. Pickup or delivery?
Perfect. Your order number is 1024, ready for pickup at 7:15. Anything else I can help with?
Thank you, Dhivya. See you at 7:15. Have a lovely evening!

salon.name: Salon
lines: Vanakkam! Thanks for calling Glow Hair Studio. How can I help you today?
Hi, how much is a women's haircut? And are you open on Sunday?
A women's haircut starts at $45. On Sundays we're open from ten to four.
Great. Could I talk to Maya about colouring my hair?
Maya's with a client right now, but she'll call you back in a few minutes. May I have your name?
Thanks, Anita. Is the number you're calling from the best one to reach you?
Perfect. Maya will call you back shortly about hair colouring. Anything else I can help with?
You're welcome, Anita. Have a wonderful day!
